reviews.text: I needed to travel for 15 days and left my dog ​​with Leandro and his team! It was fantastic, they send videos constantly and are super attentive!!! We will definitely use their services again!!! Thank you so much, Leandro!!!

I wanted to express my immense gratitude for all the work, affection, and care that Pet Hostel SL and Leandro provide for the animals. Baruch simply loved it, and so did I! I was so happy to see how much fun he had, how much he played, and how well he was cared for.

And it seems he's already formed his own group, made new doggy friends, and found a best friend, Thanos, in addition to the Rottweiler friend whose name I don't yet know. It was wonderful to see him interacting, socializing, and so happy with the other dogs.

My heart is so at peace knowing he's in a place where he receives affection, attention, and can expend all his energy. Thank you for providing these moments for him and for taking care of him with so much love and dedication.

You can be sure this was just the first of many days! Baruch will be back many times to enjoy daycare, see his doggy friends again, and especially his best friend Thanos and the Rottweiler!!! 🤎✨
Leandro is extremely attentive; he welcomes you, understands your needs and those of our dogs.

I can only express my gratitude for the service provided from day one, especially for the training of our pitbull. The results are visible from the very first lesson. Leandro was patient in teaching us, and patient with our dog, who hadn't received any commands until then. Thank you, and I will definitely recommend him to close friends and family. 10 out of 10!

I boarded my dog ​​Taurus while I was traveling, and it was incredible. I received photos and videos, which reassured me during that time, and it's clear my son was well cared for and treated. I'm very grateful for the care and affection you show the dogs. We will definitely leave him there again when needed. ☺️🙏🏾❤️✅

I'm speechless at your dedication.
My dog ​​is reactive with strangers. But his patience, the way he wins the trust of my four-legged baby. What a wonderful gift 🙏🏻
I can only thank you for your help. …
It was amazing!
I can only express my gratitude for the care you've given my princess.
Excellent professional. He helped me a lot with my dog's mobility, and he was also very helpful inside the clinic. I definitely recommend him. And if I need him again, I will certainly call him.

I left my dog ​​at Pethostel and had an excellent experience. The space is very well organized, clean, and suitable for receiving dogs safely and comfortably.
One thing I really liked was the dog pick-up and drop-off service, which makes logistics much easier for those with a busy schedule. It worked perfectly.
The owner's service also deserves mention: extremely attentive, helpful, and polite. You can tell he really enjoys what he does and cares about the well-being of the animals. My dog ​​came back calm and well.

I definitely recommend it and congratulate them on their excellent work!
Leandro was punctual, polite, attentive, and patient. THANK YOU FOR THE SERVICE PROVIDED.

I highly recommend Uncle Leandro from Pet Hostel SL!

I needed their service to accompany my pet, John Miguel, to and from the Bicho Solto veterinary clinic, and the experience was excellent. He is very attentive, careful, and responsible. He inspires a lot of confidence and affection with animals.

I will definitely hire him again!

I would like to come here and give great reviews, but only disappointment. I left my two dogs there for Christmas week, and one of them came back injured like this, due to irresponsibility. My advice is to choose carefully where you leave your dogs so you don't have the same experience as me.
(Note: the owner helped with the costs, which was the least he could do, but he didn't take good care of my dog ​​because he came back covered in spots). In other words, I trusted him once, and I trusted him a second time, and it didn't work out.
Wow, excellent service and care for our pets, the staff deserves a 1000/10!
Very good, my puppy loved it.

Leandro was very attentive and helpful from our first contact. I had an emergency situation with my dog ​​and needed Leandro's services, including transportation to the vet and accompaniment until discharge.

He kept me updated throughout the entire process, and when I needed him again the next day, he promptly came to help again.

I was satisfied and recommend Leandro's services!

It was the first time I left my dog ​​at a boarding facility and I couldn't have chosen a better place. He was very well cared for, receiving affection and attention the whole time. I traveled with a peaceful heart. Thank you for all the care! 🐾 …

I have nothing but praise for this wonderful daycare! From the first day, I noticed the care, affection, and responsibility with which they treat each pet. The team is extremely attentive and professional, always concerned about the animals' well-being. The environment is clean, organized, and inspires a lot of confidence. Safira is happy, safe, and very well cared for, which puts me completely at ease. A truly impeccable job, done with love. I recommend them without hesitation! 🙏🏻💖👏🏻
If you're traveling and don't have anyone to leave your pet with, I recommend Pet Hostel SL.

I want to express my praise for Leandro. I never imagined I would meet such a dedicated, loving, and empathetic professional! I hired an emergency UberDog service to take my dog ​​to the Savana 24hr Veterinary Hospital, and from the first contact, he offered to take him immediately and stayed with me at the hospital for hours, accompanying him through every stage of his treatment. Even when I couldn't afford private care, he guided me on how to seek public services. Unfortunately, my dog ​​passed away at home, but even then, he explained the cremation process to me. All of this demonstrates the quality of service, in what should have been just a pick-up and drop-off. Congratulations on your work, Leandro!

Great experience… with my two little ones, Mel and Lucy.
This was my first experience with Pet Hostel and the result was great.
Just seeing Lucy interacting so closely with other dogs, without fighting… haha, she used to be aggressive with other dogs.
And in just one day you managed to get her to at least stay in the same environment without fighting with them.
Mel is super sociable and loved it.
Definitely the beginning of an evolution!!!!

My first experience, my dog ​​lets me know through her behavior if she likes the place or not, and she stayed very close to Leonardo showing affection, a sign that she liked him. I received daily videos during her stay and it was great, in addition to the price which is fair. I thank you in advance for the attention to my most precious possession. Thank you, I loved the experience and will continue using your services.

Leandro is very polite, patient, and attentive. I recommend his service and will definitely request pet transportation again.
It's well worth it!
Leandro is super attentive and helpful! I highly recommend leaving your pets with him 😃🙌 …

First-class accommodation, attention and affection for our pets. Always updating and sending photos and videos. My Pandora came back beautiful, smelling wonderful, and even calmer. Thank you Pet Hostel SL.
I was away for 10 days and being able to see my Candoca every day, and in good health, was wonderful!
Boris loved it, I'd never seen him have so much fun! I loved the care you gave him and his restrictions, thank you so much Leandro and team. I highly recommend them!!!

Excellent!!!

They are attentive and took very good care of my pet!!!

I've been following Pet Hostel's work for a while now, and when I needed their services, I didn't hesitate.

I'm the owner of two lovely pets: Pandora, my German Shepherd, and Bella, my mixed-breed dog, both my passion.
I went on a trip and couldn't take Pandora with us, so I left her in the care of Le and his kind family.
It was Pandora's first time with other dogs, and I confess I was a little anxious. However, everything went so well; she made new friends and played until she was exhausted. I received photos and videos of how she was doing.

I highly recommend them.
I requested a Taxi Dog service with Leandro to take Pitucha to the vet. He was very attentive, truly enjoys what he does, and loves his four-legged friends! Thank you, Leandro! 🙏🏻 …

Extremely competent and dedicated professional. We can see that Leandro truly loves dogs, and this is reflected in the results of his work. Furthermore, he is always seeking continuous improvement through courses and training. 👏 …
My dog ​​was super tired, they treated me so well! Thank you for all the care ❤️
My Pug's stay was peaceful!

My dog ​​was very aggressive due to many changes at home. We had to travel and left him with Leandro for 8 days. We couldn't pet our little pet anymore, which made us very sad. Returning home after 8 days with Leandro, our sweet little pet now asks for affection. What joy it brought me to be able to pet my pet. Thank you for the work, I highly recommend it!

After 5 days at Uncle Lê's hotel, the princess arrived and went straight to sleep, she didn't even want dinner. I can imagine how much she and my other baby played together. Thank you so much Uncle Lê for taking care of my babies, now I can travel peacefully ❤️
An excellent professional, completely trustworthy, a trainer and a hotel that everyone needs to know about!! Thank you Uncle Le, Beethoven arrived much happier than when I handed them over to you…

I had a great experience with the services provided, thank you so much for everything Leandro! 💙
May God bless you in this beautiful profession, in which your dedication is always excellent!! …
Very good. The classes were very good, the dog had a great change and a great improvement in behavior.
Leandro provided excellent service.
It was amazing, the second year I've left him with us and I feel super relaxed. Leandro sends photos and videos, gives all the support, and he came home already bathed!! 🥰💙 …

A job done with great seriousness and excellence.
I highly recommend them! 👏🏻👏🏻 …
Sympathy

We can travel with peace of mind because she was in good hands; she didn't even want to come back, she was so happy! I highly recommend them; they are very careful and attentive. Below is a photo of the child's sadness at not wanting to go home. She wanted to stay with her uncle and her friends, Mommy!

Wow! The care they provided was amazing! I'm speechless. We left 4 dogs at the hostel and they were so happy. We received videos and photos every day. The dogs returned after 8 days in perfect condition, super happy! I loved this experience! I highly recommend it!
